statements: Consumer products encompass pest control when a firm provides it to a pensioner household for personal or domestic benefit.
The same firm may sell pest control as a B2B producer product to a food processor and as a B2C consumer product to a pensioner household.
Marketing treats pest control as a product whenever it is exchanged, whether the buyer is a food processor or a pensioner household.
A food processor purchasing pest control engages in business-to-business exchange for a producer product service.
A pensioner household purchasing pest control engages in business-to-consumer exchange for a consumer product service.
tactical_explanations: TRUE — pest control for personal or domestic benefit to a pensioner household is a consumer product service.
TRUE — Dual-channel pest control sales illustrate producer and consumer labels driven by customer type.

TRUE — B2B purchase of pest control by a food processor yields a producer product classification.
TRUE — B2C purchase of pest control by a pensioner household yields a consumer product classification.
